caption: The drawing depicts a long, flowing dress with a fitted bodice and a wide skirt that extends into a train at the back. The dress is a light cream or beige color, decorated with floral embroidery in shades of orange, yellow, and light blue. The neckline is square and outlined with an orange floral trim that is also present on the cuffs, which are wide and turned back. The same floral trim borders the opening of the skirt. The pattern of yellow-orange flowers with blue accents is scattered across the dress, particularly on the sleeves and lower skirt. The dress is presented on a headless, handless form, and the background is plain and unadorned, with a slightly aged, beige tone.
title: Dress
